name: TickLabels
description: Represents the tick-mark labels associated with tick marks on a chart axis.
remarks: This object isn't a collection. There's no object that represents a single tick-mark label; you must return all the tick-mark labels as a unit. Tick-mark label text for the category axis comes from the name of the associated category in the chart. The default tick-mark label text for the category axis is the number that indicates the position of the category relative to the left end of this axis. To change the number of unlabeled tick marks between tick-mark labels, you must change the TickLabelSpacing property for the category axis. Tick-mark label text for the value axis is calculated based on the MajorUnit, MinimumScale, and MaximumScale properties of the value axis. To change the tick-mark label text for the value axis, you must change the values of these properties.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Font
properties.description: Returns a Font object that represents the font of the specified object.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Returns a String value that represents the name of the object.

properties.name: NumberFormat
properties.description: Returns or sets a String value that represents the format code for the object.

properties.name: NumberFormatLinked
properties.description: True if the number format is linked to the cells (so that the number format changes in the labels when it changes in the cells). Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: NumberFormatLocal
properties.description: Returns or sets a Variant value that represents the format code for the object as a string in the language of the user.

properties.name: Orientation
properties.description: Returns or sets a Long value that represents the text orientation.

properties.name: ReadingOrder
properties.description: Returns or sets the reading order for the specified object. Can be one of the following XlReadingOrder constants: xlRTL (right-to-left), xlLTR (left-to-right), or xlContext. Read/write Long.

properties.name: Depth
properties.description: Returns a Long value that represents the number of levels of category tick labels.

properties.name: Offset
properties.description: Returns or sets a Long value that represents the distance between the levels of labels, and the distance between the first level and the axis line.

properties.name: Alignment
properties.description: Returns or sets a Long value that represents the alignment for the specified phonetic text or tick label.

properties.name: MultiLevel
properties.description: Sets whether an axis is multilevel. Read/write Boolean.
